Ops features F1–F10

2026-10-19 · /, /azure, command palette · local Development build against the live subscription, captured with headless Chromium at 390×844 and 1440×1000.

Not visual, so not pictured: Resource Health fault attribution on the attention sentence (F1 — both down apps answered “Unknown” today), SSL/budget/Lighthouse/rollback ntfy alerts (F3), deploy smoke test + rollback (F9), and the axe gate itself (F10).

Home cards — streak chip (F7)

  • Moved: each card's host line now starts with a flame and the clean streak: days since the app's last down or degraded day on the /azure uptime grid (30d+ = a clean window). It sits on the existing host line, so cards are no taller and the first screen still shows a whole card.
  • Screen readers hear “No outage in 30 days” / “N days without an outage”.
  • PoSeeReview is down today, so its streak is 0 and it shows no chip.

Top bar — active link contrast (found by F10)

  • Moved: the active link's label is now regular text colour; the icon keeps the accent blue. axe measured the old blue-on-wash label at 4.37:1, under the 4.5:1 AA minimum.

Command palette — app launcher (F8)

  • Moved: typing an app name now finds per-app commands: Show uptime (jumps to /azure?focus=), Open, Copy link, plus Rescan Azure now where management actions are on.
  • Fuzzy matching (“pmv” finds PoMemeVideo); weak scattered matches are cut. Before, “pomeme” matched nothing.
  • Also fixed: the palette's search/settings glyphs were missing from the icon subset.

Needs attention — Restart button (F2) and Azure Advisor rows (F5)

  • Moved: Reliability rows gain a Restart button (Start for a stopped site), shown only where management actions are on — local dev, not production.
  • New rows: Azure Advisor, grouped one row per recommendation (75 raw rows → 10), ranked as Watch unless it is High-impact Cost/Security. Each is snoozable like any other row.
  • The hero's attention count ignores Advisor's availability tips, so the page can still say “everything looks good”.

Uptime grid — error and Dependabot chips (F4, F6)

  • Unchanged on screen today, on purpose. A row gains a bug chip (exceptions in the 24h before the scan, most frequent type in the tooltip) and a shield chip (open Dependabot alerts) — but only when there is something to show.
  • Live data has none: only this site itself reports exceptions to the shared App Insights component, and Dependabot alerts are disabled on every Po repo. The chips' legend entries appear only when a chip does.
